fact: Angola's statistics office INE launched the Portal do Censo 2024 and the 'INE Angola' mobile app, which give access to census indicators, tables and maps and to statistics in PDF and Excel formats, open to any user with internet access.
INE states the definitive 2024 census results are also available on the INE portal (ine.gov.ao); the document is dated 2025-11-20.

INE's page publishes the definitive 2024 census results with download links to the publication, the summary report and an Excel file, and says results will be on its official page with 10% of microdata six months later.
